score_formula: QualityScore = Sum(Weight_i * Multiplier_i) / Sum(Weight_i) * 100 [Pass: 1.0, Warn: 0.6, Fail: 0.0]

checks.name: Schema Structure & Column Presence
checks.description: Verifies all required medallion columns exist in source payload.

checks.name: Primary Key Completeness (order_id)
checks.description: Ensures every record carries a mandatory non-null order identifier.

checks.name: Record Uniqueness & Deduplication
checks.description: Validates there are no redundant transactions with identical order IDs.
checks.remediation: Apply idempotent deduplication windowing in Silver transformation layer.

checks.name: Data Type Conformity (unit_price)
checks.description: Verifies unit prices are parseable as floating point decimals.

checks.name: Numerical Range Boundaries (qty & price > 0)
checks.description: Protects analytical models against negative orders or return anomalies.
checks.remediation: Route negative transactions to a specialized returns/reversal dataset.

checks.name: Temporal Format & Validity (ISO-8601)
checks.description: Verifies all transaction timestamps adhere to ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD standard.
checks.remediation: Use robust date-time fuzzy parser with fallback to ingestion timestamp.

checks.name: Field Completeness (customer_email)
checks.description: Tracks missing contact information affecting customer master resolution.
checks.remediation: Impute synthetic customer identifier or join with master CRM directory.

checks.name: Discount Rate Policy (0% - 100%)
checks.description: Verifies applied promotional discount percentages stay within operational caps.

checks.name: Geographic Domain Conformance
checks.description: Ensures delivery territories match sanctioned international corporate regions.

checks.name: Audit Lineage & Freshness Metadata
checks.description: Confirms every incoming row was stamped with verifiable pipeline ingestion time.

checks.name: Medallion Promotion & Quarantine Rate
checks.description: Quantifies proportion of raw input promoted to Silver vs quarantined for defects.
checks.remediation: Inspect quarantine logs to triage high defect volumes.
